headline: GOLD MINERS Q2 BONANZA: Barrick +50%, Newmont +47%, Kinross +61%, Agnico +57% — Sector P/E Compressed to 13-20x Despite Near-Record Profits
snippet: The gold mining sector's Q2 2026 earnings week closed with across-the-board near-record results — the second-best quarter in the sector's history — as Barrick reported $1.217 billion net profit (+50% YoY) on $5.29 billion in revenue from 796,000 ounces of gold, Newmont posted $2.10 adjusted EPS (+47% YoY), Kinross earned $0.71 adjusted (+61% YoY), and Agnico Eagle delivered $3.05 adjusted (+57% YoY), all beating analyst consensus estimates. The paradox Investing.com identifies is the most important structural setup in mining equities right now: profit margins are the widest in sector history at $2,900–$3,000/oz realized profit at current gold prices, yet analyst P/E multiples have compressed to 13–20x — the cheapest valuation the sector has ever carried relative to its own earnings during a gold bull cycle, implying either a historic re-rating is imminent or the market is pricing in a gold price correction that the current macro environment does not support.

headline: STIBNITE HITS ALL THREE: Perpetua PPTA Returns 16.2 g/t Au + 1.7% Sb AND Discovers New Tungsten Zone — Idaho's Most Strategic Resource Just Got Bigger
source_name: Streetwise Reports / Perpetua Resources Corp. (Nasdaq: PPTA)
snippet: Perpetua Resources Corp. (Nasdaq: PPTA) reported August 10, 2026 results from its first exploration drilling program at Stibnite Gold Project in Valley County, Idaho in nearly a decade — delivering a triple-critical-mineral discovery: Hangar Flats returned 6.4 metres at 16.2 g/t gold and 1.7% antimony near surface plus a separate 3.0-metre intercept at 14.5 g/t gold; and the Clark Tunnel Fault Zone delivered a brand-new gold-tungsten zone at 21.3 metres of 3.2 g/t gold and 0.9% tungsten, with nearby holes returning 22.9 metres at 3.2% antimony and 1.2% tungsten. Stibnite is the only large-scale permitted US domestic gold-antimony project, backed by a DoD royalty interest under national security provisions, and now carries demonstrated tungsten mineralisation in addition to its 3.1 million ounces of indicated and inferred gold resources and 99.8 million pounds of antimony outside current reserves — a domestic supply of three simultaneously strategic defence materials at a single permitted Idaho site is an exceptional and extremely rare combination that has no peer in the current US critical minerals pipeline.

headline: COPPER AT 2-MONTH HIGH $14,000: US Stockpiles Surge Record 200,000 Tonnes Ahead of Trump Tariff Call — Morgan Stanley Assigns 43% Probability to Jan 2027 Start
snippet: London Metal Exchange copper climbed to $14,000 per tonne — a two-month high — as traders accelerated US-bound pre-tariff stockpiling at a record pace: more than 200,000 metric tons arrived in the US in July alone, the largest single-month inflow in IHS Markit shipping data going back to 2014. President Trump has yet to make a final decision on refined copper import tariffs following a July proclamation requesting a Commerce Secretary report before deciding whether to impose a phased structure — 15% from January 2027, potentially rising to 30% from 2028 onward — with Morgan Stanley assigning 43% probability to the January 2027 start date. For junior copper project developers, the strategic message is durable: whether or not the tariff formally lands, the US is repositioning its copper supply chain away from import dependency at exactly the moment when AI data centre buildout, grid electrification, and EV infrastructure are driving the most sustained structural copper demand increase in the metal's history.

headline: GOLD ABOVE $4,430 AS FED PAUSE HITS 54%: Mining Stocks Post Best 5-Day Run Since 2008
snippet: Gold held firmly above $4,430 per ounce on August 13, 2026 — with futures touching $4,470 intraday on August 12 — as Federal Reserve September rate pause probability climbed to 54% following July CPI coming in at 3.4%, below June's 3.5%, effectively removing the last clean argument for a near-term rate increase. For gold mining equity investors, the most significant data point is not the gold price itself but the equity leverage it generated: GDX and GDXJ posted their best five-day performance since 2008 on the same move, confirming that gold's breakout above $4,350 is transmitting at the operating-margin level and that the mid-year junior mining selloff created the entry point for what is now behaving like the start of the next leg of miner outperformance.

headline: 2.70% Li2O OVER 10.5m AT ROSE WEST: Critical Elements CRE Adds 300×300m Block to Quebec Lithium Zone in 10,000m Summer Program
source_name: Investing News Network / Critical Elements Lithium Corporation (TSX-V: CRE)
snippet: Critical Elements Lithium Corporation (TSX-V: CRE) on August 12, 2026 released Phase 2 assay results from its 10,000-metre summer 2026 drill program at the Rose West Discovery in Eeyou Istchee, Québec, including up to 2.70% Li2O over 10.50 metres and broad zones of 1.0–1.9% Li2O over 14–27 metres in Pegmatites 2, 3, and 5 — with eleven holes totalling 2,073 metres in the NE Main Target Area expanding the mineralized footprint over a 300×300 metre block. Rose West's parent project carries a 2023 feasibility study showing a 65.7% after-tax IRR and US$2.2 billion NPV at 8% discount — economics modelled against lithium prices that have since more than doubled, suggesting a refreshed feasibility at current input prices would generate NPV figures substantially above the prior study.

headline: BARRICK Q2: $5.29B REVENUE, 796,000 oz GOLD — EARNINGS SURGE 50% to $1.22B as World's Largest Gold Miner Sets Sector Pace
source_name: GlobeNewswire / Barrick Mining Corporation (TSX: ABX; NYSE: B)
snippet: Barrick Mining Corporation (TSX: ABX; NYSE: B) reported August 10, 2026 second-quarter results showing $5.29 billion in revenue on production of 796,000 ounces of gold and 56,000 tonnes of copper, with net profit of $1.217 billion — earnings of 73 cents per share adjusted (+50% year-over-year), beating the Zacks consensus estimate of 81 cents. As the sector's largest gold producer by revenue, Barrick's Q2 results set the earnings floor for what has become the mining industry's second-best quarterly reporting season on record, with all four senior gold majors posting 47%–61% YoY EPS growth in a single week — a signal that the gold price's sustained hold above $4,350 is fully translating into income statement leverage at even the highest-cost tier of the sector.

headline: TSX-V WEEKLY WRAP: BCM RESOURCES SURGES 229% — Junior Miners Lead Market as Gold Rally Broadens Into Micro-Caps
snippet: For the week ending August 13, 2026, BCM Resources led all TSX Venture Exchange gainers with a 229% advance, according to the Investing News Network weekly TSX-V recap, as the broader junior mining sector rally extended beyond the GDX/GDXJ headline names into micro-cap explorers. The TSX Venture Exchange's 2.4% single-session surge on August 12 to 936.53 — combined with the week's sustained gold mining equity outperformance — produced a broadening participation pattern that is historically associated with the second phase of bull markets in junior miners, where early institutional money in large-caps rotates toward smaller names once the macro narrative becomes consensus.

headline: GDX: NEW ALL-TIME HIGHS BY YEAR END? GoldSeek Makes the Technical and Fundamental Case
snippet: GoldSeek's latest analysis argues that the VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) is set up for new all-time highs by year-end 2026, combining the confirmed breakout from the February–July falling wedge pattern with the sector's second-best quarterly earnings season on record — a dual technical and fundamental alignment that the analysis characterises as among the most reliable setups in equity markets. With GDX top-25 components averaging all-in sustaining costs near $1,436/oz against a $4,350–$4,470 gold price range representing roughly $3,000/oz in gross margin, and with P/E multiples compressed to 13–20x versus historical averages of 30–50x during prior gold bull cycles, the analysis contends that reversion to mean valuation multiples alone — without any further gold price appreciation — would require GDX to approximately double from current levels.

headline: VERTEX MINERALS ASX SHINES ON GOLD MINE UPDATE: Top Australian Junior Miner of the Week as ASX Small-Caps Rally With Majors
snippet: Vertex Minerals Ltd (ASX: VTX) led Australian junior mining stock performers for the week ending August 13, 2026 on a gold mine operational update that outperformed broader ASX resource sector gains, according to the Investing News Network's weekly ASX mining recap. The week's strength in Australian junior gold miners mirrors the global sector pattern: gold above $4,400/oz, combined with the ASX's exposure to exploration-stage projects in established Australian gold camps, is generating outperformance in small-cap explorers at the same time that majors are reporting near-record Q2 earnings — the breadth of the rally extending to ASX micro-caps is the hallmark of bull market second-phase participation.

headline: GOLD SWOT: MINING STOCKS TEEING UP FOR FURTHER GROWTH — GoldSeek Weekly Analysis Flags Insider Buying and M&A Activity as Bullish Structural Signals
snippet: GoldSeek's regular Gold SWOT (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats) weekly analysis identifies gold mining stocks as 'teeing up for further growth' in its most recent edition, citing the structural alignment of near-record Q2 earnings, the confirmed GDX technical breakout from a multi-month wedge pattern, and sector M&A activity signalling major producer confidence in sustained elevated gold prices. The SWOT framework notes that the primary weakness — energy and labour cost inflation — is being more than offset by the gold price's structural hold above $4,350, and that the primary opportunity — valuation re-rating from historically compressed multiples — remains largely unrealised by the market, making the current setup the type that institutional fund flows tend to discover only after retail sentiment has already turned positive.
